About AirNova

Who We Are

AirNova Engineers is a specialist HVAC engineering company dedicated to providing innovative climate control and automation solutions. Our team of experienced engineers and technicians delivers complete HVAC lifecycle services — from first design through years of reliable operation.

We combine engineering expertise with advanced EC fan technology, intelligent controls, and energy optimisation strategies to build sustainable HVAC systems that lower operating costs and extend equipment life across residential, commercial and industrial facilities.

Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning (SITC) of adiabatic cooling systems for DX outdoor units — boosting efficiency in high-ambient conditions.

Scope

  • Supply of adiabatic systems
  • Installation on DX outdoor units
  • Testing & balancing
  • Commissioning & handover

Benefits

  • Reduced condenser temperature
  • Improved cooling efficiency
  • Lower compressor load
  • Extended equipment life

Supply, installation, testing & commissioning of UV-C germicidal (UVGI) lamps inside Air Handling Units (AHU) and Condensing/Cooling Units (CSU) — delivering continuous disinfection of cooling coils, drain pans and supply air.

Scope

  • UV-C lamp sizing & supply
  • Mounting in AHU & CSU near coils
  • Wiring & safety interlocks
  • Testing, dosage check & commissioning
  • Lamp scheduling & replacement plan

Benefits

  • Continuous coil & drain-pan disinfection
  • Eliminates biofilm, mould & odours
  • Improved indoor air quality (IAQ)
  • Chemical-free coil cleaning
